name: pr_restack
title: Restack branch
description: Restack the current branch onto the new position of its base branch. Reads nothing on GitHub; pass the results of the official reads in reads

check.description: Only report whether a restack is needed

continue.description: Continue a restack that stopped on conflicts, after resolving them

abort.description: Abort a restack that stopped on conflicts and go back to the position before it

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the target repository; when several do, the active one among them

reads.description: Results of the official GitHub MCP reads the restack needs

pull_requests.description: For a stacked branch: the result of list_pull_requests (head owner:<base branch in .pecot-base>, state all) for the branch it is stacked on

pull_request.description: The result of pull_request_read with method get for the open PR of the current branch; it decides relink

base.description: Base branch after the restack (the develop branch when the lower PR is merged)

outcome.description: What happened, or with check, what a restack would do

cause.description: Why a restack is needed (only with check, when one is needed)

pullRequest.description: Merged PR of the lower branch (only when the cause is base-merged)

pushed.description: Whether the branch was pushed (only when restacked)

relink.description: PR to save again with update_pull_request so that GitHub links its closing Issues (only after a restack onto the develop branch, with reads.pull_request)

pullRequest.description: Open PR of the branch whose body closes Issues

reason.description: What to write with update_pull_request, and why

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
